{"metadata":{"description":"Command Code balance and quota panel for DeepSeek Harness: balance and the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows as a status row under the composer.","id":"gh:1410287001","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-commandcode-quota","slug":"fuqiancheng/dsh-commandcode-quota","topics":["commandcode","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Command Code balance and quota panel for DeepSeek Harness: balance and the 5-hour, weekly and monthl"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"y windows as a status row under the composer."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-commandcode-quota"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A **Command Code balance and quota panel** for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"The plugin renders a compact status row directly underneath the DSH composer:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **5-hour, weekly and monthly usage windows** as live percentages
- **Available balance**
- Click t"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"he row to expand the full breakdown: used / limit / remaining / reset time, total spend, tokens, dai"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ly spend, subscription and account information
- **Three status lights** — normal / low balance / ex"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"hausted. The current one lights up and the others dim, driven by the official `belowThreshold` and `"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"exceeded` fields; hover any light for an explanation
- **The bar color follows usage**: cool while u"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"sage is low, warming up past 55%, red near the limit, with an internal gradient
- **Six bar palettes"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"** to choose from in the gear settings; the choice is remembered
- **Overrun warning**: based on thi"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"s period's daily average, the monthly card adds a line like “~N days until empty” when the remaining"},{"id":"p5s9","text":" credit will not last until reset
- A skeleton screen shows on first load so the layout does not jum"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"st until reset

There is no account switcher, and your API key never reaches the browser."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness with the Web client (`dsh web` or the desktop app)
- Node.js 20 or newer
- A Comm"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ss with the Web client (`dsh web` or the desktop app)
- Node.js 20 or newer
- A Command Code API key"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### From npm (recommended)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"DSH expands the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` into your profile, so no manual patch editing is needed."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### From a local checkout"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Manual junction (desktop app)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The Electron desktop profile is managed by the application and does not run the `dsh plugin add` rec"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"onciliation, so register it yourself."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Link the package into the shared resolution pool:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Then add this to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"> The junction name must be exactly the package name, otherwise the host cannot resolve the import."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"After installing or changing the plugin, reload the plugin tree (the plugin page's refresh action, o"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"r a client restart)."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Key | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| `apiKeyEnv` | `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY` | Credential entry resolved through DSH's credentials service "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"|
| `fallbackEnv` | — | Optional second entry, used only when the first one is missing |
| `baseURL`"},{"id":"p25s3","text":" | `https://api.commandcode.ai` | Command Code API origin |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-request ti"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"meout in milliseconds |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Credentials live in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, or in DSH Settings → Credentials. Never commit them."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The package has two halves:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **Host half** (`src/index.js`) resolves the key through the DSH credentials service and registers "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"a read-only HTTP endpoint that fans out to the Command Code API, then aggregates the responses into "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"a single payload. The key is read on every request and never serialized to the client.
- **Client ha"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"lf** (`src/client.js`) registers a status row into the composer dock slot, polls the host endpoint, "},{"id":"p29s5","text":"and renders it with DSH theme tokens so light and dark themes both work."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Polling is tiered: balance every 3 minutes (cheap), usage and subscriptions every 30 minutes (expens"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ive). Polling pauses while the page is hidden and refreshes fully when it comes back."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Data comes from four Command Code endpoints, each called with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| Endpoint | Used for |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| `GET /alpha/billing/credits` | Balance and the 5-hour / weekly limits |
| `GET /alpha/usage/summar"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"y` | Spend, tokens and the period start (for daily spend) |
| `GET /alpha/billing/subscriptions` | S"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"ubscription status and period boundaries |
| `GET /alpha/whoami` | Account information |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"The monthly window is composed from the usage total plus the remaining credits, with the reset time "},{"id":"p34s2","text":"taken from the subscription period."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"### Behaviour under failure"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- The four requests run in parallel, so total latency is the slowest one rather than the sum.
- A co"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"nnection-level failure is retried once; a deliberate timeout is not retried.
- On failure the panel "},{"id":"p36s3","text":"falls back to the last successful value (kept for 6 hours) and reports it as stale.
- That snapshot "},{"id":"p36s4","text":"is also written to `$DSH_HOME/dsh-commandcode-quota-cache.json`, so it **survives a restart**. It ho"},{"id":"p36s5","text":"lds quota fields only — no account details, and never the key itself.
- The snapshot is keyed by a f"},{"id":"p36s6","text":"ingerprint of the API key, so switching keys never reuses another account's data.
- An HTTP 401 is n"},{"id":"p36s7","text":"ever masked by cached data, because it means the credential itself is wrong.
- When **all four** end"},{"id":"p36s8","text":"points fail, the response carries a readable reason and the panel shows an error rather than a blank"},{"id":"p36s9","text":"s fail, the response carries a readable reason and the panel shows an error rather than a blank box."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"The tests stub the credentials service, the web server, `fetch` and React, so they run offline and n"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"ever touch a live DSH instance."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
